parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board coverage guide: states which unit types are covered by the Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance (rent control, just cause, registration, deposit interest). Yields rent control and just cause coverage facts; no screening or algorithmic content.

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance coverage
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to most multifamily units built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. Newer construction (CO after June 1980), newer single-family tenancies, most condos, and some subsidized units are not subject to rent control.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.key_value: Rent control for pre-1980 multifamily units
rules.exemptions: Golden duplex, owner shares kitchen/bath, ADU with owner-occupied property (tenancies after Nov 7, 2018), university dorms, nonprofit cooperatives; new construction with CO after June 1980, single-family tenancies from 1996, most condos, certain Section 202/811 and HUD-insured subsidized units are not rent controlled.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant
single-family tenancy began on or after 1996-01-01

rules.conflict_note: Exact cutoff stated as 'before 1980' and 'CO after June 1980'; June 1, 1980 date is approximate. Single-family homes with pre-1996 tenancies are also covered regardless of build date.
rules.interaction: Local ordinance governs alongside the state Tenant Protection Act; units under local rent control are generally exempt from the state cap.

rules.title: Berkeley Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause eviction protections apply to nearly all rental units in Berkeley, including newer construction, post-1996 single-family tenancies, and most condos. Exempt are golden duplexes, owner-shared kitchen/bath units, owner-occupied ADU properties, university dorms, and nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.key_value: Just cause applies to fully and partially covered units
rules.exemptions: Golden duplex, owner shares kitchen or bath, ADU with owner-occupied property (tenancies after Nov 7, 2018), university dorms, nonprofit cooperatives.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement coverage
rules.requirement: Landlords of covered units, including partially covered units, must pay interest on security deposits. Exempt units are not subject to it.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Single-family home with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.key_value: Security deposit interest on covered units
rules.exemptions: Golden duplex, owner shares kitchen or bath, ADU property with owner-occupancy, university dorms, nonprofit cooperatives.
